description: This Java class 'SecretFromPathReader' reads a secret value from a file at a given path, encapsulating the file content into a Secret object with the file name as the secret's name. It provides static factory methods for instantiation and implements the Supplier interface to return an Optional<Secret>.

classes.name: SecretFromPathReader
classes.description: An immutable class that reads a secret from a file path and provides access to it as an Optional<Secret>.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance using the Path, deriving the secret name from the file name.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance with explicitly provided secret name and path.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the Secret read from the file, if successful.

methods.name: tryToReadSecretFromPath
methods.description: Attempts to read the secret from the file, logging a warning if it fails.

methods.name: readSecretFromPath
methods.description: Reads all lines from the file, checks if not empty, and constructs a Secret object.
